components.title: API process host
components.rationale: Owns process startup, Fastify listen lifecycle and reconciler host/watchdog bootstrapping.

components.title: Fastify application composition
components.rationale: Builds Fastify, observability, readiness, operational/protected routes and the protected runtime module.

components.title: Application services and ports
components.rationale: Application-facing use cases, authorization/start-run boundaries and explicit ports.

components.title: API-owned domain behavior
components.rationale: Domain behavior owned by the API bounded application rather than provider adapters.

components.title: HTTP entrypoints
components.rationale: Inbound HTTP registration and request boundary code.

components.title: Infrastructure adapters
components.rationale: Concrete infrastructure implementations behind API application boundaries.

components.title: Runtime module composition
components.rationale: Protected runtime composition and operational hook wiring.

components.title: API plugins
components.rationale: Environment, logging, observability and other host-level plugin concerns.

components.title: API runtime services
components.rationale: Long-lived runtime concerns such as reconciliation health and startup/shutdown coordination.

components.title: API database support
components.rationale: API-local database support code that is physically separate from @dvt/adapter-postgres.
